question.hu: Melyik munkakörben dolgozik a legtöbb alkalmazott?
question.en: Which job titles are held by the most employees?

sql: SELECT jobtitle, COUNT(*) AS employees FROM humanresources.employee GROUP BY jobtitle ORDER BY employees DESC LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Mennyi a havi fizetéses (salaried) alkalmazottak átlagos betegszabadság-órája?
question.en: What is the average number of sick leave hours of salaried employees?

sql: SELECT AVG(sickleavehours) AS avg_sick_leave_hours FROM humanresources.employee WHERE salariedflag = true;

question.hu: Kik dolgoznak jelenleg az Engineering (mérnöki) osztályon?
question.en: Which employees currently work in the Engineering department?

sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh JOIN humanresources.department d ON d.departmentid = edh.departmentid JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = edh.businessentityid WHERE d.name = 'Engineering' AND edh.enddate IS NULL;

question.hu: Melyik alkalmazottnak a legmagasabb a jelenlegi órabére?
question.en: Which employee has the highest current hourly pay rate?

sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, eph.rate FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory eph JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = eph.businessentityid WHERE eph.ratechangedate = (SELECT MAX(e2.ratechangedate) FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory e2 WHERE e2.businessentityid = eph.businessentityid) ORDER BY eph.rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Mikor kezdődnek és végződnek a műszakok?
question.en: What are the start and end times of the shifts?

sql: SELECT name, starttime, endtime FROM humanresources.shift ORDER BY starttime;

question.hu: Hány álláspályázó szerepel az adatbázisban?
question.en: How many job candidates are in the database?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS candidates FROM humanresources.jobcandidate;

question.hu: Hány bolti kapcsolattartó (store contact) személy szerepel?
question.en: How many people are stored as store contacts?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS store_contacts FROM person.person WHERE persontype = 'SC';

question.hu: Melyik országnak van a legtöbb állama vagy tartománya?
question.en: Which country or region has the most states and provinces?

sql: SELECT cr.name, COUNT(*) AS provinces FROM person.stateprovince sp JOIN person.countryregion cr ON cr.countryregioncode = sp.countryregioncode GROUP BY cr.name ORDER BY provinces DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Hány cím van Seattle városában?
question.en: How many addresses are in the city of Seattle?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS addresses FROM person.address WHERE city = 'Seattle';

question.hu: Hány személy kért e-mailes promóciós ajánlatokat?
question.en: How many people have opted in to email promotions?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS people FROM person.person WHERE emailpromotion > 0;

question.hu: Melyik telefonszámtípus a leggyakoribb?
question.en: Which phone number type is the most common?

sql: SELECT pnt.name, COUNT(*) AS phones FROM person.personphone pp JOIN person.phonenumbertype pnt ON pnt.phonenumbertypeid = pp.phonenumbertypeid GROUP BY pnt.name ORDER BY phones DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Melyik városokban van a legtöbb bolt a székhelyük (Main Office) címe alapján?
question.en: In which cities are the most stores located, based on their main office address?

sql: SELECT a.city, COUNT(*) AS stores FROM sales.store s JOIN person.businessentityaddress bea ON bea.businessentityid = s.businessentityid JOIN person.addresstype at ON at.addresstypeid = bea.addresstypeid JOIN person.address a ON a.addressid = bea.addressid WHERE at.name = 'Main Office' GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY stores DESC LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Melyik termék-alkategóriában van a legtöbb termék?
question.en: Which product subcategory contains the most products?

sql: SELECT psc.name, COUNT(*) AS products FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON psc.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid GROUP BY psc.name ORDER BY products DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Mely termékek tartoznak a Clothing (ruházat) kategóriába?
question.en: Which products belong to the Clothing category?

sql: SELECT p.name FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON psc.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = psc.productcategoryid WHERE pc.name = 'Clothing' ORDER BY p.name;

question.hu: Hány darab termék van raktáron az egyes raktárhelyszíneken?
question.en: How many units are in stock at each inventory location?

sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(pi.quantity) AS units FROM production.productinventory pi JOIN production.location l ON l.locationid = pi.locationid GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY units DESC;

question.hu: Melyik termékből van a legtöbb raktáron, az összes helyszínt összesítve?
question.en: Which product has the largest total stock across all locations?

sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(pi.quantity) AS units FROM production.productinventory pi JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pi.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Melyik termékről írták a legtöbb értékelést, és mennyi az átlagos pontszáma?
question.en: Which product received the most reviews, and what is its average rating?

sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS reviews, AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_rating FROM production.productreview pr JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pr.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY reviews DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Hány munkarendelésnél keletkezett selejt az egyes selejtezési okok szerint?
question.en: How many work orders had scrap for each scrap reason?

sql: SELECT sr.name, COUNT(*) AS work_orders FROM production.workorder wo JOIN production.scrapreason sr ON sr.scrapreasonid = wo.scrapreasonid GROUP BY sr.name ORDER BY work_orders DESC;

question.hu: Melyik termékmodellhez tartozik a legtöbb termék?
question.en: Which product model has the most products?

sql: SELECT pm.name, COUNT(*) AS products FROM production.product p JOIN production.productmodel pm ON pm.productmodelid = p.productmodelid GROUP BY pm.name ORDER BY products DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Mely termékeknek van legalább három bejegyzése a listaár-történetben?
question.en: Which products have at least three entries in their list price history?

sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS price_entries FROM production.productlistpricehistory h JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = h.productid GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY p.name;

question.hu: Mennyi a munkarendelések gyártási lépéseinek tényleges költsége helyszínenként?
question.en: What is the total actual cost of work order routing steps at each location?

sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(wr.actualcost) AS actual_cost FROM production.workorderrouting wr JOIN production.location l ON l.locationid = wr.locationid GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY actual_cost DESC;

question.hu: Mely alkatrészeket használják a legtöbb összeszerelt termékben?
question.en: Which components are used in the most product assemblies?

sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.productassemblyid) AS assemblies FROM production.billofmaterials b JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = b.componentid WHERE b.productassemblyid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY assemblies DESC LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Hány tranzakció van a tranzakciótörténetben típusonként?
question.en: How many transactions of each type are in the transaction history?

sql: SELECT transactiontype, COUNT(*) AS transactions FROM production.transactionhistory GROUP BY transactiontype;

question.hu: Hány beszerzési rendelés vár még jóváhagyásra (pending státuszú)?
question.en: How many purchase orders are still pending?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_orders FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader WHERE status = 1;

question.hu: Mely termékekből utasították vissza a legtöbb darabot a beszerzéseknél?
question.en: Which products had the most rejected units in purchase orders?

sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(pod.rejectedqty) AS rejected FROM purchasing.purchaseorderdetail pod JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pod.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY rejected DESC LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Mely beszállítók preferáltak és egyben aktívak is?
question.en: Which vendors are both preferred and active?

sql: SELECT name FROM purchasing.vendor WHERE preferredvendorstatus = true AND activeflag = true ORDER BY name;

question.hu: Mennyi az egyes beszállítóktól érkezett beszerzési rendelések átlagos szállítási díja?
question.en: What is the average freight charge of the purchase orders from each vendor?

sql: SELECT v.name, AVG(poh.freight) AS avg_freight FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader poh JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON v.businessentityid = poh.vendorid GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY avg_freight DESC;

question.hu: Mely beszállítóknál a legrövidebb az átlagos szállítási átfutási idő?
question.en: Which vendors have the shortest average lead time?

sql: SELECT v.name, AVG(pv.averageleadtime) AS lead_time FROM purchasing.productvendor pv JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON v.businessentityid = pv.businessentityid GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY lead_time LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Hány értékesítési rendelés van az egyes rendelési státuszokban?
question.en: How many sales orders are there in each order status?

sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

question.hu: Melyik akciónak a legnagyobb a kedvezmény-százaléka?
question.en: Which special offer has the highest discount percentage?

sql: SELECT description, discountpct FROM sales.specialoffer ORDER BY discountpct DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Mely termékek szerepelnek a legtöbb akcióban?
question.en: Which products are included in the most special offers?

sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS offers FROM sales.specialofferproduct sop JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = sop.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY offers DESC LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Milyen vásárlási okot adtak meg leggyakrabban a rendeléseknél?
question.en: Which sales reasons are given most often for orders?

sql: SELECT sr.name, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM sales.salesorderheadersalesreason x JOIN sales.salesreason sr ON sr.salesreasonid = x.salesreasonid GROUP BY sr.name ORDER BY orders DESC;

question.hu: Melyik értékesítő felel a legtöbb boltért?
question.en: Which salesperson is responsible for the most stores?

sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, COUNT(*) AS stores FROM sales.store s JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = s.salespersonid GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY stores DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Melyik értékesítőnek a legnagyobb az összesített értékesítési kvótája a kvótatörténet alapján?
question.en: Which salesperson has the highest total sales quota in the quota history?

sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, SUM(q.salesquota) AS total_quota FROM sales.salespersonquotahistory q JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = q.businessentityid GROUP BY p.firstname, p.lastname ORDER BY total_quota DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Melyik pénznemhez rögzítették a legtöbb árfolyamot?
question.en: For which currency are the most exchange rates recorded?

sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS rates FROM sales.currencyrate cr JOIN sales.currency c ON c.currencycode = cr.tocurrencycode GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rates DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Melyik államban vagy tartományban a legmagasabb a forgalmi adó kulcsa?
question.en: Which state or province has the highest sales tax rate?

sql: SELECT sp.name, st.taxrate FROM sales.salestaxrate st JOIN person.stateprovince sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = st.stateprovinceid ORDER BY st.taxrate DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Összesen hány darab termék van a bevásárlókosarakban?
question.en: How many items are in shopping carts in total?

sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS items FROM sales.shoppingcartitem;

question.hu: Melyik ország értékesítési területei érték el tavaly a legnagyobb forgalmat?
question.en: Which country's sales territories had the highest sales last year?

sql: SELECT cr.name, SUM(st.saleslastyear) AS sales_last_year FROM sales.salesterritory st JOIN person.countryregion cr ON cr.countryregioncode = st.countryregioncode GROUP BY cr.name ORDER BY sales_last_year DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Hány vásárló tartozik az egyes értékesítési területekhez?
question.en: How many customers belong to each sales territory?

sql: SELECT st.name, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM sales.customer c JOIN sales.salesterritory st ON st.territoryid = c.territoryid GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY customers DESC;

question.hu: Mely boltok adták le a legtöbb rendelést?
question.en: Which stores placed the most sales orders?

sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.customer c ON c.customerid = soh.customerid JOIN sales.store s ON s.businessentityid = c.storeid GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Ki adta le a legnagyobb értékű egyedi rendelést a fizetendő összeg alapján?
question.en: Who placed the single largest sales order, by total due?

sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, soh.totaldue FROM sales.salesorderheader soh JOIN sales.customer c ON c.customerid = soh.customerid JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = c.personid ORDER BY soh.totaldue DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Hány bankkártya van kártyatípusonként?
question.en: How many credit cards are stored of each card type?

sql: SELECT cardtype, COUNT(*) AS cards FROM sales.creditcard GROUP BY cardtype ORDER BY cards DESC;

question.hu: Melyik értékesítő melyik értékesítési területen dolgozik?
question.en: Which salespeople work in which sales territory?

sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, st.name AS territory FROM sales.salesperson sp JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = sp.businessentityid JOIN sales.salesterritory st ON st.territoryid = sp.territoryid ORDER BY territory;

question.hu: Hány cím van címtípusonként?
question.en: How many addresses are there of each address type?

sql: SELECT at.name, COUNT(*) AS addresses FROM person.businessentityaddress bea JOIN person.addresstype at ON at.addresstypeid = bea.addresstypeid GROUP BY at.name ORDER BY addresses DESC;

question.hu: Mi az e-mail-címe a Sales osztály jelenlegi dolgozóinak?
question.en: What are the email addresses of the employees currently in the Sales department?

sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, ea.emailaddress FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh JOIN humanresources.department d ON d.departmentid = edh.departmentid JOIN person.person p ON p.businessentityid = edh.businessentityid JOIN person.emailaddress ea ON ea.businessentityid = p.businessentityid WHERE d.name = 'Sales' AND edh.enddate IS NULL;

question.hu: Mely termékkategóriákban a legmagasabb az átlagos listaár?
question.en: Which product categories have the highest average list price?

sql: SELECT pc.name, AVG(p.listprice) AS avg_list_price FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON psc.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = psc.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.name ORDER BY avg_list_price DESC;

question.hu: Mely termékekből rendeltek a legnagyobb mennyiséget a beszállítóktól?
question.en: Which products were ordered from vendors in the largest quantities?

sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(pod.orderqty) AS ordered FROM purchasing.purchaseorderdetail pod JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pod.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY ordered DESC LIMIT 5;
